notes.title: We should talk. - Quick Pitch
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Short-form experimental narrative game
[*] Emotionally-charged communication sim
[*] Made by a diverse development team
[/list]

In We should talk, you'll use the sentence spinner to piece together modular sentences in response to the in-game characters. Choose your words carefully to express yourself as you discuss ongoing problems about life and romance with Sam, your in-game partner, over text messages, while also chatting with friends and strangers at your favorite local bar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37062163/1c8fd82e9f17ef43d441a21c94c35afc335cb6d5.gif[/img]


Our team came together with the goal of creating a game that challenges traditional transactional romance in games, and collaborated to push relationship-building games forward by expanding the realm of player choice. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37062163/614b3a72c5cf8a230e90e78a9d1e87b0457e763f.png[/img]

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
It’s been a long road, but we’ve finally launched our Steam page! Thank you to everyone who has wishlisted the game and played our demo. Your support means so much to us!

This week, [i]We should talk[/i] is taking part in the spring [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/steamgamefestival-spring]Steam Game Festival[/url] as part of the MEGABOOTH lineup. It’s been fantastic seeing the positive reception to our demo, which will be available for a limited time. Please check it out if you haven't already!

[h3][b][i]We should talk[/i] will be launching June 2020 [/b][/h3]
Coming to PC, Mac, and all major consoles! We can't wait to share the full game with all of you this summer!

To stay up to date on announcements, [url=https://twitter.com/_WeShouldTalk]please follow us on Twitter[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37062163/1a60ddf6fac0e7bbd6b23780387013d212b41ee0.gif[/img]

[h2]More about the game:[/h2]
[i]We should talk[/i] explores the nuance of words and conversation. How does what we say, and [i]how we say it[/i], change how people respond to us? How does our relationship with another person affect how we express ourselves to them? 

Using a unique dialogue choice mechanic, players assemble sentences from modular fragments to craft responses. Through texts with their partner and in person conversations with fellow patrons at a local bar, our protagonist will determine whether their romantic relationship survives the night.
[list]
[*] Have personal, intimate conversations with 4 unique characters
[*] Your choices unlock many different conversational paths
[*] Play again and again: find all 9 possible endings
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37062163/7d0fb0ffb18a8f48ada3746bab967576c5de5028.png[/img]
